Built-in ImageGen edit, 2 November 2026.
Input: vesper-blackpaw-king.png. Output: vesper-rig-v1.png.
Native alpha retained. Three equal atlas regions (torso, forward knife arm, lower cloak) are placed and pivoted independently by vesper-motion.js/.css. This is an articulated 2D composite, not a 3D model or motion video. The generated regions have separately fitted scales, so the renderer calibrates their attachment geometry rather than assuming identical registration.

Prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: three-part native-alpha texture atlas for a premium painted fantasy card game character performance. Edit supplied Vesper the Blackpaw King, preserve his EXACT dark fox identity, violet eyes, asymmetric battered gold crown, black and gold armor, two ornate curved knives, rich violet spectral cloak and painted brushwork. Produce ONE wide image with THREE equal square cells side by side (3:1 aspect ratio). Genuine transparent background throughout, NO words, labels, divider or checkerboard. Each cell contains a separately isolated animation layer from the SAME character: LEFT CELL: head, ears, crown, chest, belt/torso and rear hand holding the upright dagger on viewer RIGHT. Remove the front reaching arm, glove and curved dagger on viewer LEFT completely, repair hidden shoulder/torso beneath with matching painted armor. Remove trailing lower spectral cloak below belt, so torso ends naturally in darkness at belt. MIDDLE CELL: ONLY the forward reaching armored forearm, black glove and long curved gold/violet dagger removed from viewer LEFT; retain every detailed finger and knife, no face, no torso, no other parts. RIGHT CELL: ONLY the flowing dark tattered spectral cloak below and behind torso, with curling violet wisps and purple smoke. No arm, weapon, head or face in cloak cell. Preserve detailed organic alpha contours and smoke transparency. Parts must overlap cleanly when assembled. Preserve proportions/lighting/design. Fit each part fully inside its cell with 10 percent padding. No cropped ears or blades, no newly invented weapons or limbs. Intricate premium painted fantasy style identical to supplied art.
